summary: Enhance your skills with our Supervisory Tools for Microfinance and Small Banks Training Course. Gain essential knowledge to excel in financial oversight.
lede: Microfinance and small bank supervision training helps supervisory professionals assess institutions with distinct lending and service models. For supervisors, risk managers, and compliance officers, it addresses risk-based examination and oversight. Topics include group-lending portfolio quality, digital and operational risks, liquidity management, governance, and consumer protection, as well as evaluating financial performance and regulatory reporting.
audienceIntro: This course serves supervisory professionals, risk managers, and compliance officers responsible for oversight of microfinance institutions and small banks serving financially excluded populations.
modules: Microfinance and Small Bank Supervisory Context
Supervisory Planning and Risk-Based Examination Design
Credit Risk Assessment in Microfinance Portfolios
Operational Risk Management and Technology Platform Assessment
Consumer Protection and Market Conduct Supervision
Regulatory Compliance and Supervisory Relationship Management
Crisis Management and Supervisory Action Planning
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in banking supervision, risk management, or financial institution oversight. Basic understanding of banking principles and regulatory frameworks is essential. Familiarity with microfinance operations or small banking contexts is beneficial but not required. Participants should bring current supervisory challenges for practical application during exercises.
